tasks.short: Read and interpret biomass equipment instructions

steps.what: Locate the current asset-specific instruction manual or technical drawing and relevant page in {DOCS}, checking revision and equipment identity
Read and interpret instruction manuals or technical drawings related to biomass-fueled power or biofuels production equipment or processes, resolving ambiguity with the responsible specialist

tasks.design: Configure asset and revision filters plus page search in {DOCS}, returning original manual or drawing pages. The technician reads and interprets those originals; the view gives no generated operating instruction and controls no plant equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Asset manuals and drawing revisions can be scattered and slow to locate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native controlled-document metadata and text search can narrow retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing symbols, operating context and contradictory revisions require technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises when the manual does not fit the actual equipment.

ambition.what: No new control or maintenance authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for controlled-document access and operational review; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document search can return asset-specific source pages without replacing technical interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is actual reading and interpretation, not plant operation, maintenance execution or procedure revision. No record write is established by this statement; if actual interpretation requires a work note, separate its writing and evaluate it before estimating the broader episode.

Document control produces existing asset, document, revision and page metadata during normal publication. S1 checks identity and currency; the technician supplies the asset and question. Missing metadata or unreadable drawings fall back to manual retrieval and specialist clarification, not free new indexing or transcription.
Test native filters and search first; existing indexed retrieval earns no new gain. No answer-generation model is needed to retrieve pages. Source interpretation and all safety meaning stay in s2.
Shares are provisional active-work decomposition, not measured manual-reading times. If creating asset metadata is new work it must be charged before adopting this estimate.
research_questions: Which manual searches still require repeated folder or page navigation?

already_counted.description: Source identity checks, manual fallback and complete technical interpretation remain.

incremental.description: Verify retrieval configuration when controlled document structures change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross=20; upkeep 2 gives net 18. Low zero for already indexed asset pages or drawings with no usable searchable references, where no additional retrieval configuration is introduced. All interpretation remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Count actual parts and supplies and capture item, bin, unit, condition and count time on the stock-count sheet
Read and verify {ERP} stock records, open reservations and existing item-unit mappings against the captured count scope
Transfer exact captured counts and references into the {ERP} inventory count draft
Match the actual count against recorded quantities and calculate explicit differences and available stock under existing reservation rules in {ERP}
Manage parts and supply inventories for biomass plants by investigating differences, judging service needs and writing and checking actual inventory-review findings in {ERP}
Save the review in the same {ERP} count record without posting a stock adjustment or placing an order

tasks.design: Configure count import and exact item-unit matching in {ERP}, with explicit difference and reservation calculations. The technician still counts stock, resolves discrepancies and records supply needs; the review does not automatically post adjustments or buy parts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical counts can be re-keyed and reconciled manually against stock records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native count imports and reconciliation formulas can perform those exact operations.
tasks.still_hard: Misidentified parts, unusable stock and operational criticality require physical knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises a nominally available part that is unsuitable for safe plant use.

ambition.what: No autonomous procurement or inventory valuation adjustment.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for stock access and workflow consultation under national rules where required

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact count imports and explicit stock reconciliation can reduce re-entry while physical counting and discrepancy decisions remain manual.

assumptions: Representative inventory-management episode is an actual stock review. S1 counts and captures all physical count fields; stock custodians produce existing receipts, issues and reservation records during normal transactions. S2 verifies scope and item/unit mappings. Missing identity, units or transaction history require manual reconciliation, not inferred substitutions.

S3 explicitly performs the proposed import and s4 performs the exact comparison. Native configuration first; existing scanner imports, stock calculations and system runtime earn no new gain. If current capture already writes the count into the actual review, remove the transfer saving.

S5 includes actual written inventory findings and complete source comparison, separate from physical counting. This saved review is not a posted stock correction, purchase request, order, parts issue or external notice. A concrete episode including those actions must model their actual authority and separate final-version actions; do not extrapolate this review estimate to all inventory duties.

No self-approval gate is invented for ordinary review writing. Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. Shares are hypotheses, not measured stocktaking baselines; no new labour is transferred to stores staff.
unknowns: Review versus purchasing and adjustment mix
research_questions: Which count transfers and matches are still manual in observed stock reviews?

already_counted.description: Physical count capture, source verification and full discrepancy investigation and record checking remain.

incremental.description: Maintain item-unit mappings and test count/reconciliation handling after stock-format changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65, gross=35; upkeep 4 gives net 31. Conservative case: mixed units and unresolved part identities leave only 10 transfer/comparison points avoidable, giving 10-4=6. Physical counting, verification and discrepancy decisions remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less manual retrieval and stock reconciliation; technical interpretation, counting and plant decisions stay with the technician.
reach: Stores coordinator: learn item-unit mapping and count reconciliation controls.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish a saved review from a stock posting or purchase
role.ambitious_version: A technician with dependable source pages and traceable stock comparisons who retains technical and physical judgement.
